capabilities: Dim non-active text at line, sentence, paragraph, or section granularity
Pin granularity per note via frontmatter and scope dimming to folders
Keep lines with embeds, formulas, or tables always lit
Cycle granularity and run a diagnose command from the palette
Show on/off state and granularity in ribbon and status bar lamps
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Reading view is deliberately unsupported. Sentence granularity is line-granular due to CodeMirror limits, which the README explains. Installable via BRAT for unreleased versions.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to visually dim the rest of a note while writing, so all text stays equally lit and the active passage does not stand out.
summary: Focus-mode plugin that dims everything in the editor except the line, sentence, paragraph, or section you are working on.
